closures: Yarkon National Park (Afek and springs): summer Sunday-Thursday/Saturday 08:00-17:00, Friday/holiday-eve row 08:00-16:00; winter Sunday-Thursday/Saturday 08:00-16:00, Friday/holiday-eve row 08:00-15:00. A separate holiday-eve/Yom Kippur-eve listing closes at 13:00. Entry closes one hour before the applicable closing time. Hours are site-local, not AEST.

laws.rule: Yarkon National Park: dogs must be leashed and muzzled in the park, but are forbidden in the night-camping area. Bathing is prohibited in the artificial lake, although separate paddling pools are described. Availability of a campsite and current water-safety conditions are not established by this general page.
